title: Heat + Shade Relief Priority
summary: A guided version of the heat relief recipe for finding dense, deprivation-affected areas with weaker shade, cooling access, and older housing.
sourceNote: The project carries the real Heat Relief Priority recipe. Opening it in Index Lab loads the exact same weights, boundary level, and cumulative-burden method, with this project pinned as the comparison baseline.
details: A guided project shell for the heat relief preset, keeping the recommended score surface and cooling context visible before anyone edits weights.
The map scenes separate the final priority score from shade signals, cooling access, and the method handoff so the project reads like a small briefing rather than a raw index builder.
